description: Gauge 3D 360 turns a single KPI into a striking, three-dimensional radial gauge that communicates performance at a glance. Rather than a flat, generic indicator, your most important metric is shown against its target and color-coded ranges, so viewers instantly grasp not just the value — but whether it's strong, on track, or needs attention. Who it's for: BI developers and dashboard designers building executive and operational reports; sales, finance, operations, and service analysts who track metrics against goals; and decision-makers who need clear, at-a-glance status without digging through tables. The need it solves: Power BI's built-in gauge is visually flat and limited — it struggles to combine performance bands, custom thresholds, a target marker, and percentage context in one place, and it rarely matches a company's branding. Gauge 3D 360 closes that gap with a polished, fully customizable indicator that turns raw numbers into an immediately readable story. Key capabilities: * Three-dimensional radial design with a smooth wide arc and sense of depth * Up to 10 color-coded ranges with custom thresholds * Target/goal marker plus independent value and percentage pointers * Automatic or measure-driven percentage tracking, with its own percentage scale * Central image slot for a logo or icon * Fully customizable center labels, fonts, colors, display units, and decimals *…
